title: The board and the hand-off contracts of a team of agents, framework-free, every hand-off and pause an event
request: Phase 6 (the owner): a multi-agent system on an orchestration layer, capture everything; 28.2: the shared state and its contracts.
plan: Contracts in dclab_core with no framework import: Board, Handoff, Interrupt, TeamRecord.
Every hand-off and pause an experience event with the board's version.
Keep the whole board at every hand-off; refuse a board holding a table's value.

decisions.decision: The board holds names, codes and counts; the draft keeps the person's whole words.
decisions.why: A board is read by every node and kept at every hand-off: it must never carry rows.

decisions.decision: An answered pause raises the board's version; an open one is an event only.
decisions.why: Every change has one version; a walk waiting is not a change.

decisions.decision: Team events carry the draft as their conversation, and deleting a draft removes the orchestra files' lines of its thread.
decisions.why: Retention must remove everything a deleted draft left.

change: dclab_core/orchestra.py, experience v10 (team.handoff, team.interrupt), dclab-core 0.67.0, schemas, conformance reasons; dclab_rnd/orchestra/board.py; the spike carries a board; retention.forget removes a thread's team files; the wheel check reads the current version.

findings.defect: values_in missed fields and values inside longer text.
findings.scenario: A unit 'each biker, e.g. BK-77812', an open question naming it, a blocker naming a person passed.
findings.cause: Exact matches on a few fields.
findings.fix: Every text-bearing field read, substrings included; list items bounded.

findings.scenario: A table with a 'none' cell refused problem.labels='none'.
findings.fix: family, labels and ready are never compared; values under four characters are not either.

findings.defect: A two-line answer crashed the walk.
findings.scenario: 'When the order is placed,\nbefore a courier is assigned' raised in the analyst and the thread was stuck.
findings.fix: Whitespace made one line in the board's validator; the draft keeps the whole words.

findings.scenario: An answered pause changed the board without a version.
findings.cause: The interrupt event lacked the fields.
findings.fix: board_before and board_after on the event; an answered pause raises the version.

findings.defect: core-wheel-check failed on a stale version pin.
findings.cause: A literal version in the check.
findings.fix: It reads the current version; smoke calls for the board and the homework added.

findings.defect: Deleting a draft left its team events and board files.
findings.cause: Team events carried no conversation; the orchestra files were never cleaned.
findings.fix: Events bound to the draft; forget removes the thread's lines from the orchestra files.

findings.defect: The spike's open questions were wrong.
findings.scenario: An earlier unread answer was dropped; reaching the limit cleared the list.
findings.fix: The answered field leaves, an unread one stays.

measurements.name: the spike with a board, on JD-02
measurements.gate: every change one version, none skipped; every hand-off's board kept; pauses as events
measurements.result: every hand-off and answered pause raised the version once and in order; the whole board kept at every hand-off; open and answered pauses recorded; the walk's record kept
limits: The spike's three nodes only: the understanding and solution teams come in later packages.

outcome: A team's shared state is a contract, every change of it an event with its version, every board kept, never a row.
lessons: A value check must read every field that carries text, and never DCLab's own vocabulary.
Normalise what a person wrote into a summary field; never let it crash the walk.
risks: A long-lived project thread could reach the board's hand-off cap (400).
